spec_match.rationale: Passes audioSelection:'preferred' as a real dictionary member, links the AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum spec anchor, and correctly frames unknown-member dropping, non-detectability, and the no-causation-from-one-pair caveat.

interactive.rationale: Both buttons run real user-mediated getDisplayMedia() captures into a with/without comparison table with reset, busy-state locking, and a pagehide race guard that stops late-resolving tracks.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb promises an observational two-run outcome log with the causation caveat, which is exactly what the page delivers.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejection, video-only shares, picker-pending lockout, and post-pagehide settlement are all handled and reported distinctly.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5085785343787008 (verified) and the AudioSelectionPreferenceEnum spec anchor are both linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite ran 8/8 in this browser and includes real negative branches (no global options dictionary/enum, getSupportedConstraints excludes audioSelection, static-vs-instance placement).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: probe renders 'callable', both table rows show honest 'not run' pills, console clean (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental); the capture buttons need a real picker gesture, which cannot be driven in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert records resolved and fallback outcomes per run on top of the injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables and correct button overrides throughout, but small ivory-on-emerald 'yes' pills (~4.05:1) and the emerald 'callable' text on stone (~3.7:1) sit below WCAG AA for their size.

accessibility.rationale: The scroll region is focusable with a role and label and the table is labelled, but run outcomes update table cells with no live region, so async results are not announced to screen-reader users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-support.json records harness-validated ok/ok for this feature (2026-07-24), and the comparison table sits in an overflow-x container with a focusable scroll region; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Announce capture outcomes via a live region
openQuestions.detail: After a run settles, the audio-track pill and detail cell change silently. Add role=status text (e.g. 'with-hint run returned an audio track') or aria-live on a summary line so keyboard/screen-reader users get the result without re-reading the table.

openQuestions.title: Nudge the emerald indicator colours up to AA
openQuestions.detail: The .pill.yes ivory-on-emerald (#0a8f5c) chip measures ~4.05:1 and the .ok emerald-on-stone probe text ~3.7:1, both under the 4.5:1 normal-text bar. A darker emerald for small text (shared design-system tweak) would clear AA without changing the palette's look.

summary: A well-scoped observational demo: real hinted vs unhinted captures, honest anti-causation framing, solid edge handling (pagehide races included), correct references, an 8/8 conformance suite with genuine negative branches, and telemetry asserts. Remaining gaps are minor: results are not announced to assistive tech and the small emerald indicators fall just short of AA. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, clean console); the picker flow itself cannot be driven headlessly, so runtime evidence for the capture path is partial. Mobile parity relies on the harness-recorded ok/ok from 2026-07-24.
